description:
Code, per-data-set results and input data for a procedure that chooses the update a clinical risk model needs at external validation. It splits a misfit into four parts (overall risk, slope, curved link, misfit among patients with the same predicted risk), tests each part against the model already updated for the simpler parts, and names the parts with Holm's correction.

Version 2.1.2 uses the same reference for both marks of the burn figure and adds a check of every plotted number against the per-data-set results. Version 2.1.1 corrected the illustrative curves of the concept figure. Version 2.1.0 gave the final title and author order and adds the worked example of the software section (worked_example.R, worked_example.txt). Version 2.0.0 added the updated-model reference (localize_update.R), the part sizes (localize_size.R), the main simulation with its per-data-set results (sim3_rows), the comparisons with closed testing and the Brier-score procedure (sim2d_rows, rows_davis), the applications, the stress tests and the scripts for every table and figure.
